# Grass Valley Generators

> Whole-house standby generator installation, cost information, and service for Grass Valley, Nevada City, and western Nevada County, California.

- Website: https://grassvalleygenerators.com/

## Services
- Whole-house standby generator installation
- Standby generator service and annual maintenance
- Free in-home generator estimates, plus a ballpark estimate on the website in about a minute

## Service area
Grass Valley, Nevada City, Penn Valley, Lake Wildwood, Alta Sierra, and the rest of western Nevada County, California.

## Pricing
The leading Generac dealer serving this area publishes an average installed cost of $13,000 to $16,000. Size, fuel run, electrical panel condition, placement, trenching, and permits affect the final quote. A far-lower quote usually leaves something out of scope. A ballpark range is available on the website; a real quote requires an in-home look at the panel, fuel, and placement.

## Install wait
8 to 10 weeks from prepayment at that same booked-out dealer, per its published timeline.

## Sizing (planning guide)
- Essentials only (fridge, lights, outlets, furnace fan, phone and internet): about 10-14 kW
- Most of the house (essentials plus well pump, kitchen, laundry and one AC unit): about 18-22 kW
- Whole house (including AC, electric range, dryer and well pump): about 22-26 kW

Well pump startup surge, AC tonnage, and electric heat can push a home up a size. Confirm at the in-home estimate.

## Fuel
Mostly propane. Much of Nevada County has no natural gas service, so the generator ties into the home's propane tank, or a tank set is added to the quote.

## Maintenance
Once a year: oil, filters, plugs, battery check, and a test run under load.

## Brands
Generac is the most common locally. Kohler and Cummins standby generators are also installed and serviced in this market.

## Why this area
Nevada County is in PG&E public safety power shutoff (PSPS) territory. Many homes run on well pumps, propane, and long driveways. In the October 2026 shutoff scope, about 2,137 PG&E customers in Nevada County were in line to lose power; on one storm day, November 18, outages peaked at 5,019 customers out. 30.4% of the county is 65 or older.

## Contact
Request a free in-home estimate with the form at https://grassvalleygenerators.com/#book
